discovery: Web search of public scholarly literature, including PubMed/PMC, journal and author-hosted records. Search focused on temporally varying sensory input, bounded and nonlinear decisions, temporal expectation, mouse behavior, choice history, joint choice/RT and primacy. Selected primary research with a relevant manipulation, measurement or model prediction. No meta-analysis or exhaustive screening.
